admission.justification: Spans DependentDeferral/DeferralCondition/DependentRecord in records.py, DEFERRAL_PREFIXES in ids.py, and IDENTIFIED_ENTRY_KEYS in canonical.py, and is guarded by byte-identity serialization tests.

applicability: Every ar-dependent/v1 record serialized or parsed in a converted memory tree.
conditions: Each deferral carries a unique minted DFR- ID, non-blank passage, reason, owner, createdAt, createdByLeaf, and a condition naming at least one of task or file.
fileBlob is present if and only if condition.file is set.
When no deferral is open, the deferrals key is omitted completely.
exclusions: Non-dependent record kinds, which do not admit deferrals.
Derived deferral state (open, due, orphaned) and age, which are computed on read and never stored.
statement: A dependent record stores explicit deferrals keyed by minted DFR- IDs with passage, reason, task-and/or-file condition, fileBlob when a file is named, owner, createdAt and createdByLeaf, and omits deferrals when empty so records without deferrals remain byte-identical.
title: Dependent records store explicit DFR- deferrals and omit empty lists
